article_title.ru: Ручной захват показывает оператору пределы будущего движения робота
article_title.en: A handheld gripper exposes the robot's movement limits during recording
article_title.ja: 手持ちのつかみ具で、記録中にロボットの可動限界を確認

caption.ru: Ручной захват помогает записывать движения для обучения роботизированной руки. В исследовании RUMI гарнитура показывает оператору виртуальную руку, позволяя учитывать ограничения её суставов. Условная редакционная сцена начала захвата коробки; персонаж, форма устройства и мебель обобщены.
caption.en: A handheld gripper records demonstrations for training a robot arm. In the RUMI study, a headset shows the operator a virtual arm so its joint limits can be considered during recording. This conceptual editorial scene shows the start of grasping a box; the person, device shape and furniture are generalized.
caption.ja: 手持ちのつかみ具で、ロボットの腕に学習させる動作を記録する。RUMIの研究では、頭に着けた機器に仮想の腕を表示し、関節の可動範囲を確かめながら記録できる。箱をつかみ始める場面を題材にした編集イラストで、人物、装置の形、家具は一般化して描いた。

alt.ru: Чёрно-белая гравюра: женщина-инженер восточноазиатской внешности стоит у рабочего стола в гарнитуре. Правой рукой она управляет ручным двухпалым захватом: плоские кончики касаются противоположных боковых поверхностей небольшой коробки, дно которой стоит на столешнице. На устройстве закреплена небольшая камера. Левая рука согнута у пояса. Обе ноги и ступни полностью видны и опираются на пол; стол имеет устойчивые опоры. Фон белый, надписей и экранной графики нет.
alt.en: Black-and-white engraving of an East Asian woman engineer wearing a headset at a workbench. Her right hand operates a handheld two-finger gripper whose flat pads contact opposite sides of a small box resting on the tabletop. A small camera is mounted on the tool. Her left arm is bent at her waist. Both complete legs and feet are visible and supported on the floor; the bench has stable supports. The background is white, with no writing or interface graphics.
alt.ja: 白黒の版画。東アジア系の女性技術者が頭に機器を着け、作業台の前に立つ。右手で手持ちの二本指のつかみ具を操作し、平らな指先が小さな箱の両側に触れている。箱の底は天板に載っている。装置には小型カメラが付き、左腕は腰の近くで曲げている。両脚と床に着いた両足が見え、台にも安定した脚がある。背景は白く、文字や画面の図はない。

visual_thesis: Одна статья rumi-recording-constraints: качество записанного движения зависит от его совместимости с механикой будущего исполнителя. Показано начало записи движения коробки ручным захватом и использование гарнитуры. Виртуальная рука видна только оператору и не изображена как физическое устройство. Сцена не воспроизводит точную конструкцию RUMI или внешность авторов; она не объединяет опыт с людьми, физические испытания робота и отдельную симуляцию сил.
visual_brief:
Use case: illustration-story. Create exactly ONE original landscape editorial illustration for a robotics newspaper, about 3:2. One coherent research action, no montage or split panels.

Black ink on pure white: Soviet mid-twentieth-century popular-science engraving language, strong confident outlines, substantial expressive black shapes, disciplined sparse hatching and crosshatching for volume, ample untouched white. Modern robotics with dignified realistic human anatomy. No color, sepia, tinted paper, wash, neon, decorative borders, symbols, logos, letters, numbers, graphs, text, watermark, fake interface or wall poster.

Subject grounded in the engineering article "RUMI" dated 2026-11-16: a handheld two-finger demonstration gripper, mechanically matched to a robot gripper, lets a person record box-moving demonstrations while wearing a mixed-reality headset. The headset can display a virtual robot arm to the wearer; do NOT draw a solid autonomous robot or a floating physical arm. This is a conceptual editorial scene, not a documentary likeness of the researchers or a claim to reproduce their apparatus exactly.

Show exactly ONE adult East Asian woman engineer standing beside a simple clean laboratory workbench. She wears a plain professional technical jacket, trousers, closed shoes and a compact headset with a correctly supported head strap. Attractive harmonious realistic face, light face and hands, visible focused mouth and nose, natural proportions, calm dignity. Show her entire body, both complete legs from hips through knees to two shoes planted on the floor, comfortably inside the frame. No posing or gaze at the viewer.

Her specific visible action: with her right hand she operates a SMALL HANDHELD two-finger gripper on a plain small rectangular box on the workbench. Device extends forward from the back of her right hand; her thumb and index squeeze the REAR scissor input pads. A compact solid housing above the back of the hand connects continuously to two short articulated mechanical fingers in front. Two opposed flat fingertip pads meet the left and right vertical faces of the SAME box. The fingers close toward each other horizontally. The box is at the initial grasp stage, its flat bottom still RESTS on the tabletop, so no floating load. Rear scissor input, connected housing, two articulated fingers, opposed contacts and supported box must be visually clear. Keep the mechanism minimal, mechanically plausible, no extra fingers, no chains, dangling ornaments, decorative handles or invented machinery. A single small plain wrist camera mounted on top of the tool faces the grasp. No readable branding. Her wrist and forearm naturally align with the tool. Her free left hand rests lightly on the table away from the contact, not touching or obscuring the box or gripper. Head faces the work, headset directed at the same box. Human hand, input pads and device must not merge or penetrate each other.

Composition: clear side-front three-quarter angle showing the two contact pads and box sides. Place the compact experiment toward the nearer open portion of the bench so it reads at newspaper size. Human and device are the main focus. A little modern/futuristic furniture through a smooth rounded tabletop and simple sturdy supports, with continuous structural connection from tabletop to floor, open legroom. White background with almost no room clutter; no chair, screens, extra instruments or cables unless indispensable. Do not embellish the apparatus beyond the minimal shapes described.

Visible causal chain: the operator squeezes input pads -> connected linkage closes two jaws -> flat pads meet opposite box sides -> box rests stably on the bench; both human feet and bench feet bear weight on the floor. All critical contacts must be readable even when reduced. Original editorial engraving, not photorealism and not a technical blueprint.

Targeted correction applied:
Edit this illustration with two essential physical/compositional corrections. Preserve the original woman, both complete legs and shoes on floor, her right hand operating the handheld gripper, gripper-to-box contacts, supported box, bench, pure black ink engraving on pure white, light face and hands. FIRST: remove the detached hand on the far-right tabletop completely. Give the woman an anatomically connected LEFT arm: shoulder through visible sleeve and bent elbow to a short forearm with her left hand resting naturally at her waist, close to her body, clearly continuous, not on the far side of the table. Only two human hands total. Her working right arm and hand stay unchanged. SECOND: erase the entire dotted/dashed virtual robot arm and both dashed sight rays from the headset. The space above the box becomes clean white empty background. No projection graphics, fake interface, text, extra objects or poster. Keep the headset itself; only the wearer sees its imagery. Do not crop feet or alter the physical two-jaw gripper and box. Critical final audit: every human hand connects to a complete anatomically plausible arm; both feet stand on floor; box rests on table and is contacted on opposing sides by the tool pads.
